intent: Preview logo exploration; no concept selected or applied
prompts:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original logo exploration board for "Cloud Burrito", a developer's desktop AWS investigation/productivity application. This is concept exploration for a new brand identity, not an edit. A memorable friendly yet sophisticated developer tool, warm editorial design, not a restaurant, not a generic corporate cloud provider. Make the artwork flat vector-like, precise curves, crisp edges, clean optical proportions, no gradients, no 3D, no mockup photography, no textures, no bevel, no watermark, no fake UI. Landscape 3:2 composition. Warm ivory background (#e9eddf). Charcoal (#141612) and warm orange (#ff8657), optional muted sage (#a2b58d) used sparingly. Main hero logo large centered in upper two thirds with generous negative space, exact lowercase wordmark "cloud burrito." underneath in a distinctive refined rounded grotesk, balanced tight kerning and bold weight. Bottom strip separated by one thin line: show the exact same mark as a solid monochrome silhouette, then as a compact dark rounded-square app icon, then at tiny favicon scale. These are applications of ONE consistent logo, not additional designs. Clean small top-left concept identifier, exact text specified below. Use only the concept identifier and "cloud burrito." as text, no other captions. Design should be recognizable at 24px with strong silhouette and no tiny details.
Concept identifier: "01 / CLOUD FOLD".
Logo: Invent one beautiful compact cloud silhouette with three rounded upper lobes and a distinctive lower-right corner folded inward like a burrito wrap. The wrapping gesture is made with a decisive diagonal negative-space opening that also subtly suggests a forward chevron, meaning follow an investigation. The cloud and folded wrapper are ONE integrated bold symbol, not a cloud above a separate food container. Slightly asymmetrical, confident and immediately recognizable, not a cone or ice-cream silhouette. Ivory and warm orange against a charcoal hero backing shape only if needed for contrast, or a charcoal cloud with orange fold directly on ivory. Keep it exceptionally simple: one coherent outer shape and one cut, no faces, no circuit traces, no toppings, no literal tortilla details. Premium but approachable.

Concept identifier: "02 / WRAPPED SIGNAL".
Logo: Create a distinctive compact monogram symbol where a broad rounded open C wraps around a simple softly double-lobed B-shaped core. The overall mark should feel like a folded ribbon holding a small cloud, with a playful opening/negative-space seam, not like a standard font monogram. Strong custom geometric drawing with softened square corners, thick bold masses, a slight forward direction. One interlocked symbol, no outlines thinner than the main masses, no disconnected floating dots, no circuit diagrams. Warm orange for the wrapping C, charcoal for the integrated core. It must remain intelligible as a single-color silhouette. Avoid resemblance to crypto coins, chain links, banking seals, shopping bags or existing provider logos. No food illustration and no face.

Concept identifier: "03 / LITTLE BURRITO".
Logo: Design a charming but restrained small cloud-burrito character as a professional developer tool mascot mark. One chunky oblong rounded wrap shape leaning slightly, with a soft three-lobed cloud peeking from the top. The lower wrapper makes a clean diagonal fold. Two tiny charcoal dot eyes in the cream cloud, no mouth or at most a very subtle short smile. No arms, legs, hat, chef costume, food toppings, vegetables, utensils or restaurant badge. The main wrapper is warm orange with one charcoal/ivory negative-space fold. It should be a confident lovable app icon, contemporary flat geometric character design, high silhouette readability, minimal details, not a detailed cartoon or emoji. Have the personality come from proportions and posture. Same exact character in all three applications along the bottom.
